# CANDIDATE: GAP_FILL_VOL_IMBALANCE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A gap-down open followed by bullish volume imbalance and ATR compression often leads to a gap fill as short-term pressure reverses. The edge exists because panic-driven gap downs exhaust sellers, creating latent buying pressure that manifests as volume imbalance and low volatility before mean reversion.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** If today's open < prior close × 0.998 (gap down ≥0.2%) AND the first 5‑minute bar closes above its open AND (buying volume – selling volume) / total volume > 0.3 (using up/down volume as proxy) AND ATR(5) < 0.8 × ATR(20) (volatility compression) AND price > VWAP, then go long at next bar open.  
**Exit:** Initial stop at gap low (or most recent swing low) or premium‑stop 0.5% (whichever is tighter). Primary target at prior close (gap fill) or 1R, then trail runner with 20% chandelier exit from highest high since entry. Exit also triggered if price closes below VWAP after entry.
